profiles.forgotBody: A PIN can't be recovered: Sati keeps no copy anywhere. The only way out is to delete this profile and all its data on this device. A backup file can bring it back.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.sub: Each profile has its own tasks, routines and stats.

welcome.boxesTitle: Every task goes in one of 4 boxes
welcome.box1: Has to be done today. Goes into your Top 3 first.
welcome.box2: Matters, but can wait. Give it a focus session.
welcome.box3: Small or quick. Do them together in one short block.
welcome.box4: Not worth your time. Let it go.
welcome.intro: A calm place for your work: pick 3 things a day and focus on one at a time.
welcome.name: Your name
welcome.privacy: Everything stays on this device. No account, no login.
welcome.notifBody: Sati can alert you for reminders, the end of a focus session, your morning plan and your evening review, with sound and vibration.

notifyInfo.title: How alerts work on your phone
notifyInfo.p1: Sati has no server. Alerts are scheduled by the app itself, on this device.
notifyInfo.p2: They are most reliable when Sati is installed to your home screen and was opened recently. If the app has been closed for a long time, missed alerts are shown the next time you open it.
notifyInfo.p3: iPhone / iPad: needs iOS 16.4 or newer. Open Sati in Safari, tap Share, choose "Add to Home Screen", then open Sati from the home screen and allow notifications.
notifyInfo.p4: Android: in Chrome, open the menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
notifyInfo.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser or phone settings.
notifyInfo.default: Notifications are not turned on yet.
notifyInfo.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. On iPhone, add Sati to the Home Screen first.
notifyInfo.notInstalled: Not installed yet: running in the browser.

settings.areasSub: Used to group tasks. Tap × to remove one.

settings.heldNote: During a focus session, all other app alerts are held in the notifications list until it ends. Reminders always come through.
settings.dataNotice: No account, no login, nothing sent to a server. Each profile's data is kept separate. Clearing your browser data deletes it, so keep a backup.

settings.pinOn: On · asked when switching to this profile
settings.deleteBody: All tasks, routines, reminders and history of this profile will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.

landing.title: Sati · Install the focus app
landing.description: Pick 3 things a day and focus on one at a time. Free, private, works offline. Install on Android, iPhone or your computer.
landing.heroTitle:
Calm mind.
One thing at a time.
landing.heroBody: Sati is a focus app for your phone. Pick the 3 things that matter most today, then do them one at a time in 45-minute focus sessions.
landing.installed: Sati is installed on this device.
landing.iosHint: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
landing.featuresTitle: What you need to focus. Nothing more.

f.top3Body: Choose what matters most (3 by default, you can change it) and let the rest wait.
f.focusBody: A timer you can pause, with a 10-minute break between sessions.
f.matrixBody: Sort ideas into 4 boxes so you know what to do first.
f.routinesBody: Study, exercise, or anything you do every day.
f.remindersBody: Alerts with sound and vibration for reminders and the end of a session.
f.profilesBody: Keep work and study apart, each one can have a PIN.
f.offlineBody: Opens instantly, even with no signal.
f.privateBody: Everything stays on your device. No sign-up.

landing.howBody: Sati installs straight from your browser, like an app from a store, in a few seconds.

android.s2: Tap “Install Sati” at the top, or open the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app”.
android.s3: Open Sati from your home screen and allow notifications.

iphone.s1: Open this page in Safari (iOS 16.4 or later).
iphone.s2: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
iphone.s3: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap “Add”.
iphone.s4: Open Sati from the home screen and allow notifications. On iPhone, alerts only work in the installed app.

desktop.s1: Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
desktop.s2: Click “Install Sati”, or the install icon at the right of the address bar.
desktop.s3: Sati opens in its own window, like any other app.

faq.a1: Yes. No subscription, no ads, no account.
faq.a2: Only on your device. You can save a backup file and restore it in Settings.
faq.q3: Why not in the app stores?
faq.a3: Sati is a web app (PWA): you install it straight from the browser. It is small and updates itself.
faq.a4: Sati alerts you while the app is open or was used recently, and catches up on anything you missed when you open it again.

landing.footer: Free and private. Your data never leaves your device.
